note: Open questions that must be answered before certain decisions can be reasonably made, with what we already know, what is missing, and how to discover it. Status values: 'open', 'gated', 'partially answered'.

questions.question: What products do the five submitted link tokens intend to identify?
questions.known: The five submitted URLs and their tokens (S-14). Four submitted links resolved on 2026-11-20 to observed Amazon listings (P-01/02/03/05); those observed targets are recorded separately from the intended tokens and are not merged with them.
questions.missing: An authoritative statement of what each token is meant to be (the tokens themselves do not match Amazon's documented 10-character ASIN format — FLG-001).
questions.discover: Open each submitted link in the enrolled Associates account/browser session and record the destination; or have the owner confirm each intended product.
questions.blocks: Any statement that the site 'is about' five specific products; product-spec claims; scaling to more links.

questions.question: Do the submitted short links — and the provisional tagged URLs on the site — satisfy the Associates Special Links requirements?
questions.known: The Operating Agreement requires links to use the special 'tagged' link formats Amazon provides (S-01). The brief says the short links' exact compliance status is unresolved and must not be called invalid (FLG-003).
questions.missing: Result of the one-link-per-product test in the enrolled Associates workflow (destination + tracking report).
questions.discover: Associates Central → SiteStripe/Link Checker on one link per product; check the Orders report after test clicks.
questions.blocks: Bulk link replacement, adding more products, any compliance sign-off.

questions.question: What are 'the five defined events' the brief asks the analytics endpoint to record?
questions.known: The brief says 'record the five defined events' but never enumerates them. The campaign-ledger row fields the brief does enumerate are timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks, reported orders (data/ledger.json).
questions.discover: Owner supplies the list, or accepts the proposed schema (SUG-003: page_view, outbound_click, guide_read, newsletter_signup, feedback_click).
questions.blocks: Freezing the analytics event schema; dashboard design.

questions.question: Which host will run the self-hosted analytics endpoint?
questions.known: GitHub Pages cannot run server-side code (FLG-006). Reference implementations ship in tools/analytics-endpoint/ (Cloudflare Worker; Python stdlib server).
questions.blocks: Turning on the click counter (currently dry-run).

questions.question: Which reader-capture (newsletter) mechanism should the site use?
questions.known: Capture UI ships and is wired to site-config.js captureEndpoint; it collects nothing while the endpoint is null (FLG-008).
questions.missing: Provider decision (self-hosted Listmonk, Buttondown, MailerLite, etc.) and account.
questions.blocks: Live email collection; first dispatch cadence.

questions.question: What is the Google Search Console verification token for the site property?
questions.known: Sitemap, robots.txt, canonical URLs, and feed are ready (SG-28 done; SG-29 gated).
questions.missing: Verification token/file from the owner's Google account.
questions.discover: Owner creates the property and drops the token into the reserved slot (workshop page has steps).
questions.blocks: Search Console query data — which the brief wants to drive topic selection.

questions.question: Is the Associates account for tag shopnow047c-20 enrolled and in good standing?
questions.known: The tracking ID is supplied in the brief (S-14). US-format tags end in '-20', consistent with shopnow047c-20.
questions.missing: Confirmation of enrollment status, and access to Associates reports/SiteStripe.
questions.discover: Owner signs in to Associates Central; record status here.
questions.blocks: FLG-003/FLG-005 link tests; first-party order data for the campaign ledger (Priority 4: authorized first-party reports only).

questions.question: What do spec codes S01, S02, S07, S24 and SG-27..SG-30 define in the source specification?
questions.known: The brief's own wording maps SG-27..SG-30 to nav labels, RSS feed, Search Console, reader capture; S02 appears against Special Links validation; S01/S07/S24 appear against disclosure/Operating Agreement/FTC review.
questions.missing: The source specification document these codes come from.
questions.discover: Owner supplies the spec, or confirms the provisional mapping (this register + FLG-009).
questions.blocks: Treating any of those rows as fully specified requirements.

questions.question: What publishing cadence can the owner review and sustain?
questions.known: The brief requires a publishing cadence and measured topic selection. A proposal of two question-shaped guides per month plus seasonal anchors is on the decision queue (SUG-002).
questions.missing: Owner's available review time and any hard deadlines (e.g. holiday season windows).
questions.blocks: Committing the editorial calendar on the About page.

questions.question: Should the site display prices or ratings at all?
questions.known: Per verification rules, unconfirmed volatile values stay blank (FLG-010). The site currently shows none and says 'Check today's price'.
questions.missing: Decision on a compliant price/rating source (e.g. Product Advertising API) or continued omission.

questions.question: Is the site brand 'The Crisp Index' approved?
questions.known: A brand is needed for the publication front page; 'The Crisp Index' is a session proposal (SUG-001), used provisionally so the site could ship.
questions.missing: Owner approval or a replacement name.
questions.blocks: Nothing structural (name is a template constant), but masthead/marketing copy depends on it.

questions.question: What counts as a 'reported order' for the campaign ledger and any optimization?
questions.known: The brief says the ledger takes reported orders only from authorized first-party reports (Amazon Associates reports), and that no conversion score or revenue forecast is presented (Priority 4).
questions.missing: Whether to count shipped orders, dispatched items, or returned-adjusted totals; which attribution window.
questions.discover: Owner decision aligned with Associates report semantics.
questions.blocks: Ledger population; any later optimization automation.
